{"question":{"id":"q02","question":"黑色古书如何自称，并把苏天晴放在什么关系位置？","readAt":{"chapter":1,"paragraph":30},"group":"ordinary","category":"relationship","expected":"古书自称墨丘利秘典，声称从星空彼岸远行来寻找最优秀适格者，并说那个人就是苏天晴。","certainty":"supported","evidence":[{"chapter":1,"paragraph":29,"quote":"【吾名墨丘利秘典，从星空彼岸远行至此，前来寻找我最优秀的适格者。】"},{"chapter":1,"paragraph":30,"quote":"【而那个人就是你，苏天晴小姐。】"}]},"answer":{"queries":4,"sourceQueries":4,"exhausted":false,"answer":{"text":"黑色古书自称“吾名墨丘利秘典，从星空彼岸远行至此，前来寻找我最优秀的适格者。”它把苏天晴称为“苏天晴小姐”，并称“那个人就是你”，即认定苏天晴是它要找的适格者／“那个人”。","status":"answered","recordIds":[],"sources":[{"chapter":1,"paragraph":29},{"chapter":1,"paragraph":30}]},"history":[{"requests":[{"command":"source","chapter":1,"limit":10,"query":"黑色古书","perspective":"reader","world":"original"},{"command":"source","chapter":1,"limit":10,"query":"古书","perspective":"reader","world":"original"},{"command":"source","chapter":1,"limit":10,"query":"苏天晴","perspective":"reader","world":"original"}],"results":[{"schema":"neurobook.memory.query.v1","ok":true,"command":"source","snapshot":{"id":"llm-through-1","sourceManifest":"manifest:0cb898d0b1701fc4","knowledgeRevision":1,"readAt":{"chapter":1,"paragraph":76},"contentHash":"7363ae7d6240cee087f3a9a611bec00da58b0cb95fd613d0eab4f0495b10a77e"},"scope":{"readAt":{"chapter":1,"paragraph":30},"perspective":"reader","world":"original"},"items":[{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":7,"text":"苏天晴坐在床头，呆滞地看着眼前这本飘浮在半空中的黑色古书，余光从床边的落地镜中扫过，瞥见一道陌生的娇小身影——"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":13,"text":"房间中的低沉言语再次响起，将苏天晴的注意力拽回眼前这本黑色古书。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":20,"text":"黑色古书发出低沉的言语，不太明白眼前这只狐狐为什么要突然用怪异的手法去薅她自己的尾巴。"}],"coverage":{"through":{"chapter":1,"paragraph":30},"chapters":[1],"material":"complete","semantic":"partial","gaps":["未提供当前阅读范围与视角专属的语义缺口说明。"],"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false},"completeness":{"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false,"matchingRecords":3,"returned":3},"truncation":{"page":false,"depth":false,"unavailableReferences":0},"nextCursor":null},{"schema":"neurobook.memory.query.v1","ok":true,"command":"source","snapshot":{"id":"llm-through-1","sourceManifest":"manifest:0cb898d0b1701fc4","knowledgeRevision":1,"readAt":{"chapter":1,"paragraph":76},"contentHash":"7363ae7d6240cee087f3a9a611bec00da58b0cb95fd613d0eab4f0495b10a77e"},"scope":{"readAt":{"chapter":1,"paragraph":30},"perspective":"reader","world":"original"},"items":[{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":7,"text":"苏天晴坐在床头，呆滞地看着眼前这本飘浮在半空中的黑色古书，余光从床边的落地镜中扫过，瞥见一道陌生的娇小身影——"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":13,"text":"房间中的低沉言语再次响起，将苏天晴的注意力拽回眼前这本黑色古书。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":20,"text":"黑色古书发出低沉的言语，不太明白眼前这只狐狐为什么要突然用怪异的手法去薅她自己的尾巴。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":23,"text":"苏天晴干咳两声掩饰尴尬，伸手阻止了面前这本奇怪的古书继续说话，眼珠一转，飞快地理清思绪。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":28,"text":"古书沉默了一会儿，像是在思考眼前这只呆头呆脑的狐狐到底是不是自己要找的人，良久后方才重复了一遍两分钟前的开场白："}],"coverage":{"through":{"chapter":1,"paragraph":30},"chapters":[1],"material":"complete","semantic":"partial","gaps":["未提供当前阅读范围与视角专属的语义缺口说明。"],"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false},"completeness":{"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false,"matchingRecords":5,"returned":5},"truncation":{"page":false,"depth":false,"unavailableReferences":0},"nextCursor":null},{"schema":"neurobook.memory.query.v1","ok":true,"command":"source","snapshot":{"id":"llm-through-1","sourceManifest":"manifest:0cb898d0b1701fc4","knowledgeRevision":1,"readAt":{"chapter":1,"paragraph":76},"contentHash":"7363ae7d6240cee087f3a9a611bec00da58b0cb95fd613d0eab4f0495b10a77e"},"scope":{"readAt":{"chapter":1,"paragraph":30},"perspective":"reader","world":"original"},"items":[{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":5,"text":"“……苏天晴。”"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":7,"text":"苏天晴坐在床头，呆滞地看着眼前这本飘浮在半空中的黑色古书，余光从床边的落地镜中扫过，瞥见一道陌生的娇小身影——"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":13,"text":"房间中的低沉言语再次响起，将苏天晴的注意力拽回眼前这本黑色古书。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":14,"text":"苏天晴有些茫然。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":16,"text":"看着在身侧摇曳的炸毛大尾巴，苏天晴鬼使神差地伸手，在尾巴上用力薅了一把。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":23,"text":"苏天晴干咳两声掩饰尴尬，伸手阻止了面前这本奇怪的古书继续说话，眼珠一转，飞快地理清思绪。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":27,"text":"“你是谁？”苏天晴扭头正视眼前这本书，茫然地说道。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":30,"text":"【而那个人就是你，苏天晴小姐。】"}],"coverage":{"through":{"chapter":1,"paragraph":30},"chapters":[1],"material":"complete","semantic":"partial","gaps":["未提供当前阅读范围与视角专属的语义缺口说明。"],"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false},"completeness":{"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false,"matchingRecords":8,"returned":8},"truncation":{"page":false,"depth":false,"unavailableReferences":0},"nextCursor":null}]},{"requests":[{"command":"source","chapter":1,"from":20,"to":30,"limit":10,"perspective":"reader","world":"original"}],"results":[{"schema":"neurobook.memory.query.v1","ok":true,"command":"source","snapshot":{"id":"llm-through-1","sourceManifest":"manifest:0cb898d0b1701fc4","knowledgeRevision":1,"readAt":{"chapter":1,"paragraph":76},"contentHash":"7363ae7d6240cee087f3a9a611bec00da58b0cb95fd613d0eab4f0495b10a77e"},"scope":{"readAt":{"chapter":1,"paragraph":30},"perspective":"reader","world":"original"},"items":[{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":20,"text":"黑色古书发出低沉的言语，不太明白眼前这只狐狐为什么要突然用怪异的手法去薅她自己的尾巴。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":21,"text":"不疼的吗？"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":22,"text":"“咳咳！等一下，稍等一下！”"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":23,"text":"苏天晴干咳两声掩饰尴尬，伸手阻止了面前这本奇怪的古书继续说话，眼珠一转，飞快地理清思绪。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":24,"text":"我重生了。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":25,"text":"重生成了一只金毛狐女。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":26,"text":"那么眼前这本黑色会说话的书是怎么回事？有人能给我解释一下吗？"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":27,"text":"“你是谁？”苏天晴扭头正视眼前这本书，茫然地说道。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":28,"text":"古书沉默了一会儿，像是在思考眼前这只呆头呆脑的狐狐到底是不是自己要找的人，良久后方才重复了一遍两分钟前的开场白："},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":29,"text":"【吾名墨丘利秘典，从星空彼岸远行至此，前来寻找我最优秀的适格者。】"}],"coverage":{"through":{"chapter":1,"paragraph":30},"chapters":[1],"material":"complete","semantic":"partial","gaps":["未提供当前阅读范围与视角专属的语义缺口说明。"],"recordsExhausted":false,"corpusClosed":false},"completeness":{"recordsExhausted":false,"corpusClosed":false,"matchingRecords":11,"returned":10},"truncation":{"page":true,"depth":false,"unavailableReferences":0},"nextCursor":"eyJ2ZXJzaW9uIjoxLCJxdWVyeSI6IjI2N2U3ZTZjMDhjOWYyNjZjYzk4OTE4ODcyOTBhNjViOGJjOWQzYThkZmQxNWNjYWI2NWM5NmQyNTVkZTFmNDgiLCJvZmZzZXQiOjEwLCJjaGVja3N1bSI6ImY2MzRjMzhiM2VkOTA1YTZiN2M5ZTk0Y2ZhOTc1YTQxNGNlMzVkYzY1OGQxNjU0MDA0ZGM2NDI1YzI5M2QxNzcifQ"}]}]},"citedSources":[{"chapter":1,"paragraph":29,"text":"【吾名墨丘利秘典，从星空彼岸远行至此，前来寻找我最优秀的适格者。】"},{"chapter":1,"paragraph":30,"text":"【而那个人就是你，苏天晴小姐。】"}]}
